mechanism: Tobramycin (aminoglycoside) may cause nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity, which could be potentiated in patients with renal impairment; rilpivirine has minimal renal clearance but both drugs require monitoring in renally compromised patients.
action: Monitor renal function and audiometry during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration; consider therapeutic drug monitoring for tobramycin; assess baseline and ongoing renal function.
